info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API enables users to retrieve the current status of retail orders within the system. This endpoint provides essential information about the lifecycle of orders, offering insights into processing, shipped, and delivered statuses. Typical consumers of this API include order management systems, e-commerce platforms, and customer service tools that need to monitor order progress. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure timely updates and enhance customer satisfaction with accurate order tracking.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of orders in the system. It helps in tracking the progress of orders and understanding their current state, whether they are pending, processed, shipped, or completed.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of orders. This body specifies the criteria and filters for the status request, ensuring the correct information is obtained.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status of orders.

ListRetailOrdersStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation related to the orders status.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.title: Order Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the order.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the order in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the order status.

audit.description: Audit information related to the order processing.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.description: Response object containing the status of an order request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: User or system that created the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the order was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information regarding the order processing.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
